title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity and version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Morgan Lee
description: Summary: This PR aligns auth/retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bumps package versions. Motivation: several downstream teams hit subtle differences in retry behavior and streaming boundary handling which caused production regressions during a recent canary. To avoid ongoing duplication and reduce maintenance overhead we bring parity to higher-level SDK behaviors and update packaging for a coordinated release. Changes include: 1) Auth + retry parity: unified token refresh hooks, consistent transient error classification, and a shared retry backoff profile (exponential with jitter, max_attempts configurable). Python gains a new AuthClient wrapper to match TS/Go behavior; TS/Go adopt a shared retry util (moved to internal/common). 2) Streaming API ergonomics: consistent event types for streaming responses (data|error|end), improved reconnect semantics for intermittent network drops, and incremental decoding helpers for Python/TS to match Go's emitter pattern. 3) Parity fixes: corrected edge cases around multi-chunk function-calling events and fixed header propagation for proxied requests. 4) Version bumps: python 0.8.2 -> 0.9.0, typescript 1.2.3 -> 1.3.0, go v0.4.5 -> v0.5.0. 5) Tests & docs: added cross-sdk integration tests (mock server), updated CHANGELOGs and migration guides. Checklist: - [x] implement unified retry policy across sdks - [x] add auth wrapper for python - [x] port streaming helpers to TS/Go parity - [x] add unit & integration tests - [x] update changelogs and release notes - [x] bump package versions Notes for reviewers: focus on retry policy defaults and the migration instructions; the default max_attempts remains conservative to avoid increased load. Backwards compat: all public APIs are backwards-compatible by default; opt-in flags are provided for stricter behavior. Linear/Jira refs: ENG-2345, ENG-2401, SUP-8421

release_notes: SDKs: unify auth/retries and streaming behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Bug fixes for streamed function-calling events and header propagation. Version bumps: python->0.9.0, typescript->1.3.0, go->v0.5.0. See docs/migrations/sdk-auth-retries.md for migration steps.
additional_context: CI: full matrix (linux/mac/windows) passed after a rerun; integration suite exercises streaming reconnects and retry scenarios. No database migrations. Monitoring: added metrics sdk.retry.attempts and sdk.streaming.reconnects to help rollouts.
migration_notes: Python: replace direct token refresh usage with AuthClient wrapper (see examples in README). TypeScript: import retry from 'internal/common/retry' instead of legacy helpers. Go: use internal/retry package API; update callers to pass Context for cancellation. All SDKs: default retry.max_attempts=3 unless overridden.
changelog_highlight: Unified retry policy + streaming parity; bug fixes for function-calling streams; coordinated SDK version bump for release.
testing_summary: Added 14 new unit tests and 6 integration tests covering: token refresh race, transient network reconnects, retry backoff behavior, and multi-chunk function-calling sequences. Local perf validation shows negligible latency increase for successful fast-path requests; retry traffic limited by default attempts.
risk_assessment: Low: no breaking public API changes, opt-in stricter behaviors behind flags. Moderate operational impact if default retry attempts are raised; conservative defaults retained. Monitoring hooks added to track anomalies.
notes_for_release_engineering: Coordinate simultaneous packages publish for py/ts/go. Tag release: sdk-unify-auth-retries-2026-02. Ensure internal common package is published before dependents. Update SDK docs site with migration page link.
